notes: Neuropathy/sensitive-feet and plus-size statics (user 2026-10-30). No medical claims (no 'say goodbye to neuropathy', 'reduces burning and tingling', 'doctor recommended', 'pain free', 'diabetic shoe'). Meta personal-attributes policy: no 'you have neuropathy/diabetes' wording; condition named only in a customer quote or as 'sensitive feet'. NP_03 quote is paraphrased from Trustpilot language: replace with the verbatim review before running. Offer = standard 40% (BOGO and 50% not approved).

Upper middle: a white rounded box with heavy red-magenta all-caps headline on two lines "GENTLE ON / SENSITIVE FEET". Three small white rounded boxes with bold black text placed around the shoes: "Soft knit, no stiff seams" (left), "Wide toe box, no pinching" (right), "Cushioned rocker sole" (lower left). Lower right: a round magenta badge with small white "TODAY" and big white "40% OFF". All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin. No other text anywhere.
